# FRAMEWORKS DRUM — llms.txt
> The living, sorted collection of every AI framework, charter, regulation, and article the estate has mined — from the Mac estate and the open web. A knowledge pack in the harness mono repo (master-harness/knowledge/frameworks-drum).

## Core
- Master framework document v1.4 (the operating doctrine — task-allocation complementarity, 5 MAPE-K stages, conformal 90/10 router, [Dorado] market-leg doctrine): docs/MASTER_FRAMEWORK.md
- Validation research (literature grounding + caveats): docs/RESEARCH_VALIDATION.md
- Wiring (MCP / A2A / llms.txt / registry + Destinations map): docs/WIRING.md
- Scorecard (automated, measured — regenerated by ops/scorecard.py): docs/SCORECARD.md
- Corrections ledger (append-only): docs/CORRECTIONS_LEDGER.md
- Trust-flip deep research (the nonconformity score that can clear coverage): docs/RESEARCH_TRUST_FLIP.md
- Benchmark-as-a-service + engine-axis doctrine: docs/BENCHMARK_AS_A_SERVICE.md, docs/ENGINE_AXIS.md
- Execution queue (NEXT 100 set 2): docs/NEXT_100_MOVES.md
- Overnight runbook (02:30 daily cycle): ops/OVERNIGHT_RUNBOOK.md
- Master index (machine-readable): catalog.json
- Pack README: README.md

## Feeds (delivery channels)
- feeds/reg_events.json — 126 regulation events, east/west/global — DORADO reg-bank sync source + SOV SIGNAL regulatory-pressure features
- feeds/eat_7box.json — the drum's honest 7-box EAT self-check (measured → CI'd → signed → chained → anchored → boarded → mirrored)
- feeds/status_overnight.json — last overnight cycle's status card (counts, gates, measured labels, archive entries)

## Collections
- frameworks/ — one card per governance/management framework (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OECD AI Principles, UNESCO, …)
- charters/ — one card per charter / declaration / principles set (estate 52-article charter, Asilomar, Bletchley, Seoul, Paris, …)
- regulations/ — one card per binding or near-binding instrument (EU AI Act, CRA, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, US state AI laws, Korea AI Basic Act, …)
- articles/ — one card per article / paper (human-AI complementarity, agentic AI, model merging, MCP/A2A, governance loops)

## Machine access
- MCP server (stdlib-only, JSON-RPC over stdio): mcp/frameworks_drum_server.py — tools: drum_catalog, drum_search, drum_get, drum_crosswalk
- MCP manifest: mcp/manifest.json
- A2A agent card: a2a/agent-card.json

## How it stays living
Raw mining lands in _mining/; `python3 build_catalog.py` re-folds everything into catalog.json + per-kind cards; the MCP server reads catalog.json on every call.
